$comment: Generated by Tools/moon-albedo-bake/bake-lola-normals.mjs. Checked in as the provenance + relief evidence for the bundled lunar normal map. Tools/visual-regression/moon-normal-map-asset.spec.mjs re-derives the shipped file's sha256 and rejects this manifest if they disagree.

source.product: NASA/GSFC SVS 4720 — CGI Moon Kit, LOLA displacement map
source.units: float32 kilometres relative to a 1737.4 km sphere

derivation.downsample: exact area-weighted average (mean elevation of the ground each output texel covers)
derivation.differencing: central difference; longitude stencil widened to round(1/cos(lat)) texels so the east baseline stays a constant GROUND distance
derivation.poleHandling: rows past a pole wrap ACROSS it to the antipodal longitude on the same row (one latitude step over the top), never clamped
